title: A 2.5-Hour Screenshot Run Still Needed Human Review
summary: Matt Corey reports that Codex completed an automated, UI-test-driven App Store screenshot run in two and a half hours, but every iPad capture showed the app windowed rather than full-screen. The automation completed its steps while missing a presentation constraint obvious during human review.
takeaway: Add machine-checkable screenshot preconditions for device class, orientation, window mode, scale, and safe area. Review one sample per target before allowing a long batch to continue.
